resources.string: Ten roles. Each name is set in its own size and weight.
Six colour roles. They follow the theme, so each stays readable at night.
Ink carries everything you read first.
Accent marks what you can act on.
Danger says this cannot be undone.
Warning asks you to look again.
The same passage in the two body roles. Both get extra leading; the compact one is for cards and dialogs.

A glaze is thin where the clay shows through and deep where the colour pools. Type on a screen works the same way: the letters matter, and so does the space left between the lines. Body text is given a little more leading than a label, so that the eye finds the start of the next line without looking for it.
The same heading and row at two text scales. The switches move together.
Every size grows by the same share

The ten sizes, the leading of body text and the 1.13 larger-text scale were extracted from the original app. The named roles and tones, and the paragraph that keeps Chinese punctuation off the start of a line, were designed for Sancai.
